Labels the connected components of a raster: every group of valid cells that touch each other gets its own number.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Labeling, Connected components, Patches, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Labeler`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap` | raster file |  |  | The raster to label: its valid cells are the ones to group. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMap` | output file |  | The raster of the labels, the number of the component of each valid cell. |
